test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: When the sender and receiver of an email are on the same system, we need only _______ user agents.
solution:
The correct answer is **Two**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• "two" might suggest that each user operates a** separate user agent even on the same system, perhaps due to user profiles or account settings **that segregate their activities for privacy or organizational purposes. 
 
• However, it's important to **note that technically, only one user agent is required to handle both sending and receiving emails for multiple** users on the same system.
 
• The choice of** "two" in this context serves as an assumption to fit the available options and is not a reflection of actual necessity.**
